question_text: Across all crowd-mode cameras (ExpoFloor_MainAisle, DemoBooth_NVIDIA, DemoBooth_Intel, KeynoteHall_Stage, FoodCourt_North) on 2025-12-08 (UTC), which location showed the most extreme peak-to-baseline contrast — meaning the largest ratio of its peak head_count to its overnight quiet-hour average head_count? Identify the camera_location and explain the ratio order of magnitude.
answer_text: The location with the most extreme peak-to-baseline contrast on December 8, 2025, is the KeynoteHall_Stage, with a peak head count ratio of approximately 10.39 compared to its overnight quiet-hour average. This indicates that the peak head count was over ten times higher than the average, reflecting a significant surge in activity during that period.

citations.cypher:
WITH 
  [ 'ExpoFloor_MainAisle', 'DemoBooth_NVIDIA', 'DemoBooth_Intel', 'KeynoteHall_Stage', 'FoodCourt_North' ] AS locations,
  [ '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z', '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z' ] AS time_bounds
MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)-[:AT_CAMERA]->(c:Camera)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(l:Location)
WHERE l.name IN locations AND ch.hour_utc >= time_bounds[0] AND ch.hour_utc < time_bounds[1]
WITH l.name AS camera_location, ch.peak_hc AS peak_head_count, ch.avg_hc AS avg_head_count
WITH camera_location, peak_head_count, avg_head_count, 
     CASE WHEN avg_head_count > 0 THEN peak_head_count / avg_head_count ELSE 0 END AS ratio
RETURN camera_location, ratio
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 1
